stem: A wheel with moment of inertia $0.50\text{ kg m}^2$ starts from rest. A constant torque of $2.0\text{ N m}$ acts on it for $3.0\text{ s}$. What is the final angular velocity of the wheel?
markscheme: $\alpha = \tau / I = 2.0 / 0.50 = 4.0\text{ rad s}^{-2}$; $\omega = \alpha t = 12\text{ rad s}^{-1}$
